item.title: Python Import Placement Strategy: Performance vs. Circular Dependencies vs. Readability
item.description:
“Python Import Placement Strategy: Performance vs. Circular Dependencies vs. Readability”

Where should import statements reside in Python code? The default convention, suggested by PEP 8, places them at the module’s top. However, scenarios arise where placing imports within functions or conditional blocks becomes strategically beneficial. This exploration delves into the consequences—performance implications, dependency visibility, and structural benefits like avoiding import loops—associated with these different placement strategies.
